title: NFTMinterV2 and dispatchers use unchecked `transfer`/`transferFrom` (no SafeERC20)
description: Raw IERC20 calls ignore return values. While primary Behodler tokens may revert on failure, the design allows registering arbitrary ERC20s as `token` in `_executeMint` — combined with H-01, this compounds the free-mint risk: even a token that returns false (rather than reverting) on transferFrom failure silently "succeeds", and the minter computes actualReceived=0 and proceeds to mint. For the downstream dispatcher transfers, silently failing transfers let accounting drift (protocol "dispatched" when no tokens moved).
impact: Amplifies H-01 and introduces silent-failure risk throughout the V2 codebase. Combined with H-01, any token that does not revert on failed transfer is automatically exploitable.
attack_path: Fake ERC20 returns false on transferFrom.
Free V2 NFT mint (same as H-01).
recommendation: Use OpenZeppelin SafeERC20 everywhere: `safeTransfer`, `safeTransferFrom`. Alternatively, require the transfer return-value be true explicitly.
